description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::RecipeImporter class, which encapsulates the business logic for importing recipes into different projects within the Coocook application. It manages attributes related to projects, recipes, ingredients, and related articles and units, and provides methods for identifying candidate matches and importing data.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::RecipeImporter
classes.description: A class implementing the business logic for importing recipes into different projects, including attribute definitions, data fetching, candidate identification, and data import methods.

methods.name: _build_ingredients
methods.description: Builds and returns the sorted ingredients of the recipe as an array reference.

methods.name: _build_source_articles
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of source articles related to the recipe's ingredients.

methods.name: _build_source_units
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of source units related to the recipe's ingredients.

methods.name: _build_target_articles
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of target articles from the project for matching.

methods.name: _build_target_units
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of target units from the project for matching.

methods.name: BUILD
methods.description: Initializes ingredient hashrefs with linked article and unit data based on source articles and units.

methods.name: identify_candidates
methods.description: Identifies candidate matching articles and units between source and target datasets based on specified keys.

methods.name: import_data
methods.description: Imports the recipe data into the project, creating new recipes and copying ingredients with mapped articles and units.
